letter.subject: Application for Graduate Engineer, Remedial
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer Remedial role advertised on SEEK through Davies Ross Consulting. The work covers building inspections, defect assessments, structural investigations and remedial documentation for a Pyrmont consultancy, and I want to build that technical path from a civil graduate base.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 at Albright Institute. The diploma centred on road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. My degree included structural principles, and I have modelled a pedestrian Warren truss bridge in Revit and footing and column work in AutoCAD as public portfolio pieces.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer and then field engineer. That work covered drawing review against construction, site inspections, quality checks, crew coordination and progress records on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works.

I live in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card and an Australian driver licence with transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I have not held a paid remedial or façade engineering role yet; recent graduates are encouraged in the advert and I am ready to learn under senior engineers.
Resume and portfolio are ready at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering my application.
